title: The Longest Prefix That Appears Again Later in the Word

concept.title: A prefix that appears again starting at the position i has the length at most z[i]; the best is the maximum of z[1..]
body: Find the length of the **longest prefix of the word that occurs again** somewhere else in the word (starting at a later position; the two occurrences may overlap). For `abcabcab` the prefix `abcab` occurs again at the position 3, so the answer is 5. For `abcd` no prefix occurs again, so the answer is 0.

A prefix of length `L` occurs again at the position `i >= 1` exactly when the letters starting at `i` match the first `L` letters of the word, that is, when `z[i] >= L`. So the longest prefix that occurs again at the position `i` has the length `z[i]`, and over all positions the answer is `max(z[1], z[2], ..., z[n - 1])` (0 for a word of one letter).
The overlap is allowed: for `aaaa` the prefix `aaa` occurs again at the position 1 (`aaa` is the suffix), so the answer is 3, which is `z[1]`. The Z-function does all the work in linear time.

statement: A word `s` is given. Print the length of the longest prefix of `s` that also occurs in `s` starting at some later position (occurrences may overlap).
constraints: The word consists of lowercase English letters.

examples.note: The prefix abcab occurs again at the position 4: 5.

hints: Compute the Z-function: z[i] is how long the word matches itself from the position i.
A prefix of length L occurs at the position i exactly when z[i] >= L.
Take the maximum of z[1], ..., z[n - 1].

explanation: The longest prefix occurring again at the position i is z[i]; the answer is the maximum of z[1..n-1].

code.python:
import sys
input = sys.stdin.readline

def z_function(s):
    n = len(s)
    z = [0] * n
    z[0] = n
    l = rr = 0
    for i in range(1, n):
        if i < rr:
            z[i] = min(rr - i, z[i - l])
        while i + z[i] < n and s[z[i]] == s[i + z[i]]:
            z[i] += 1
        if i + z[i] > rr:
            l, rr = i, i + z[i]
    return z

s = input().strip()

z = z_function(s)
print(max(z[1:], default=0))
